{{Short description|Estonian molecular biologist}}
{{Infobox scientist|birth_date=6 April 1927|birth_place= [[Vändra]] |death_date= 30 November 1989|death_place= [[Tartu]]|fields=[[biology]]|known_for=founder of [[molecular biology]] in Estonia<br/>discovery of [[5S ribosomal RNA]]|education=[[University of Tartu]]}}
'''Artur Lind''' (6 April 1927, [[Vändra]] – 30 November 1989, [[Tartu]])<ref name="Birth">{{Cite web|url=https://dea.digar.ee/cgi-bin/dea?a=d&d=vandra20150828.2.15&st=1&l=en|last=Piirsalu|first=Hiie|title=Arstid: algus eelmises lehes|date=28 August 2015|website=Vändra Teataja|access-date=13 June 2019|language=et}}</ref> was an Estonian [[biologist]] and is considered to be the founder of [[molecular biology]] in Estonia.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://ulemistecity.ee/innovators/artur-lind/|title=Artur Lindi maja|last=|first=|date=|website=Ülemiste City|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161019022653/http://ulemistecity.ee/innovators/artur-lind/|archive-date=2016-10-19|access-date=}}</ref>

Lind studied to be a [[surgeon]] at the [[University of Tartu]]. Due to an allergic reaction to [[analgesic]]s used at the time, he was unable to continue working as a surgeon and moved to the [[Faculty (division)|faculty]] of [[biochemistry]] instead.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sirp.ee/s1-artiklid/c21-teadus/ruum-kus-sundis-eesti-molekulaarbioloogia/|title=Ruum, kus sündis Eesti molekulaarbioloogia|last=Maidla|first=Margus|date=14 October 2016|website=[[Sirp]]|language=et|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>

He is credited with the discovery of [[5S ribosomal RNA]].<ref name=":1" />

His remains are buried in Vana-Jaani cemetery in [[Tartu]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://info.raad.tartu.ee/muinsus.nsf/bf088249cbe7e9c9c2256873003aedd6/162e3ef7a101cd74c2256efd00425cea|title=Artur Lind'i (1927 - 1989) haud|last=|first=|date=|website=Tartu registry of monuments|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-06-12}}</ref> The Sepapaja 6 office building in [[Ülemiste City]] is named after Artur Lind.<ref name=":0" />
